chunk.content: Scomberomorus commerson (Lacepede, 1800), the narrow-barred Spanish mackerel, is one candidate species for 'tenggiri': a large pelagic scombrid of the Indo-West Pacific reaching 240 cm FL, with iridescent blue-grey back and numerous thin wavy vertical bands.
chunk.source_quote: Scomberomorus commerson (Lacepede, 1800) ... Narrow-barred Spanish mackerel ... Max length: 240 cm FL ... Colour of back iridescent blue-grey, sides silver with bluish reflections, marked with numerous thin, wavy vertical bands

source.title: Scomberomorus commerson, Narrow-barred Spanish mackerel: fisheries, gamefish
